messages:
Samira Khan: quick kickoff for Verdana Health onboarding. 10-min thread to align stakeholders, acceptance gates, and a 10-day pilot runway. Verdana requests Private (VPC) deployment + HSM-backed KMS, reduced logs retention, and an SOC2 evidence bundle. Planned feature-flag roll date: 2026-10-05. Pilot goals: 95th pct latency <175ms under expected bursts (~800 rps), uptime >=99.95%, and eval pass rate >=94% on 1k sample prompts. Cost target: initial unit cost < $0.012/token.

Ben Ortiz: I can own infra + network. Recommend q4 quantized model and continuous KV caching for prefix-heavy workloads. Need their staging VPN creds and allowlist IPs. Will prepare batching config and a small harness.

Megan Wu: I'll run enablement and quality tuning. Propose 3 sessions: infra handoff, prompts workshop, and monitoring/runbooks. Suggested slots: 9/22 13:00 PDT (infra), 9/24 10:00 PDT (prompts), 9/26 11:00 PDT (monitoring).

Carlos Mendez: Verdana availability afternoons PDT 9/21-9/25. Two asks: HSM KMS key rotation policy (we will provide), and can logs be retained 21 days during pilot? Also need an embeddings-only flow restricted to IDs for retrieval.

Samira Khan: we can do 21d logs retention for pilot. HSM rotation supported; will share KMS steps. Embeddings-only mode for retrieval — we can gate that and document scope. Megan, please lock invites and include Verdana's PM, Laila.

Megan Wu: invites sent. Infra handoff agenda (short):
- VPC peering & route checks
- HSM KMS key exchange + rotation cadence
- staging creds handoff to infra owner
- minimal SOC2 evidence export steps
- smoke test owner & acceptance criteria

Ben Ortiz: sample smoke test i'll run after creds:
```
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"model":"verdana-llama-q4","input":"health-check"}'
```
I'll include a harness that asserts 95th/99th pct latencies, error rate, and an automated rollback trigger. PR by EOD 2026-09-18.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: infra handoff scheduled; SOC2 export queued at /onboarding/verdana/documents.

Carlos Mendez: clarifying rollout gate: we need both latency AND quality gates. Proposal: feature-flag enablement requires 95th pct <=175ms AND eval pass rate >=94% on the 1k set during a continuous 45-min validation window at pilot rate. Also error rate <=1.5%. If breach, keep flag off and fallback to hosted.

Samira Khan: agreed. Let's also require a staged canary: 5% for 30m, 20% for 90m, then full if gates pass. Ben will add dashboard panels and canary automation.

Ben Ortiz: confirmed 1 I'll add dashboards for 50/95/99 pct, error rate, and a quality signal from the eval harness. Also adding an automated abort on quality regressions.

Megan Wu: action items captured: 1) Ben: infra config PR + harness + canary automation (due 2026-09-18). 2) Samira: publish SOC2 export & onboarding docs (due 2026-09-19). 3) Megan: invites + agendas (done). 4) Carlos (Verdana): provide staging creds, allowlist, and HSM contact (ASAP). Reconvene after infra handoff to validate smoke test.

Carlos Mendez: creds and allowlist uploaded to Verdana vault; pinged your team. Also shared HSM contact details. :thumbsup:

Samira Khan: thanks team 5 will share a short recap doc after the infra handoff and tag owners: @Ben @Megan @Carlos. :white_check_mark:
